foot.text: rst_dst_n clears the destination FSM to D_IDLE and ack to 0. Because req is a LEVEL that the source still holds, the destination simply re-observes it and redoes the transfer. Nothing is fabricated; at worst the in-flight transfer is repeated or abandoned.
